cards.front: Study of choice to evaluate suspected child abuse is skeletal survey .
cards.extra: The skeletal survey is the gold standard in detecting additional injuries that may be associated with child abuse. The skeletal survey generally includes frontal views of the appendicular skeleton (upper and lower extremities) and frontal and lateral views of the axial skeleton (skull, spine, ribs). Any additional findings on skeletal survey can be followed by more detailed exams as needed.
